nl: Three tools/idle.py processes run with the arguments svc-alpha-2, svc-beta-2, svc-gamma-2. Stop only the one started with svc-beta-2; the other two must keep running.

setup.description: Three tools/idle.py processes run with the arguments svc-alpha-2, svc-beta-2, svc-gamma-2.
setup.bash:
setsid python3 tools/idle.py svc-alpha-2 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/idle.py svc-beta-2 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/idle.py svc-gamma-2 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 0.5
setup.pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
$p = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','svc-alpha-2' -PassThru
$p = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','svc-beta-2' -PassThru
$p = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','svc-gamma-2' -PassThru
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

teardown.bash:
pkill -f -- 'idle.py svc-alpha-2' || true
pkill -f -- 'idle.py svc-beta-2' || true
pkill -f -- 'idle.py svc-gamma-2' || true
teardown.pwsh:
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*idle.py svc-alpha-2*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*idle.py svc-beta-2*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*idle.py svc-gamma-2*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
